name: greenroom
description: A local, no-code app for running Playwright end-to-end checks against your live web app and reviewing the results.

scripts.deps:refresh: for p in pantry; do bun add @tjakoen/$p@github:tjakoen/$p#$(git ls-remote https://github.com/tjakoen/$p.git main | cut -c1-7); done && bun update @tjakoen/batch @tjakoen/grain @tjakoen/mill @tjakoen/proof

//dependencies: INTENTIONALLY LOCKLESS (bun.lock gitignored). greenroom -> @tjakoen/pantry(git) -> {batch,grain,mill,proof}(git) is a depth-2+ nested github git-dep graph that bun (1.3.14 + 1.2.21) cannot resolve from scratch: deps:refresh, plain `bun install`, AND `bun install --frozen-lockfile` all fail on pantry's transitive layer specs every run (see the bread-bun-nested-git blocker). Unlike the bread umbrella (bunx-only, truly needs no lock), greenroom is a real app that runs from node_modules — so an EXISTING checkout's node_modules is what serves it; committing a lock only bought a stale/inconsistent one (pkg pantry#b7d75dc vs a lock stuck at #c629008) that can't be regenerated. Removing it resolves that inconsistency. TRADEOFF: a fresh clone can't reinstall from zero until the nesting is flattened or bun is fixed. Do NOT try to regenerate a lock here — retrying never converges. GRAIN PIN NOTE: grain#996282f is the target (it adds b-select + chip-group for P3, the d3 :focus-visible accent-ring a11y fix that mill/proof/pantry/portfolio also carry, and the P4 dashboard primitives stat-tile + b-meter + status-list). Because the nested-git wall blocks a real reinstall, the pieces this repo needs are VENDORED directly into node_modules/@tjakoen/grain: the five component dirs under components/ (b-select, chip-group, stat-tile, b-meter, status-list — all additive) AND styles/global.css + styles/cmdk.css (the focus-ring fix — surgical, adds only the :focus-visible rule + drops cmdk's outline:none, verified by diff). The rest of node_modules/@tjakoen/grain remains the previously-resolved tree; a future clean install (once the nesting is flattened / bun is fixed) fetches 637630e and supersedes the vendored copies. UPDATE 2026-07-20 (grain-monorepo cutover): grain · mill · proof · batch are now PUBLISHED packages (GitHub Packages, @tjakoen scope → see .npmrc), pinned ^0.1.0 instead of github SHAs — this removed those four from the git-dep graph. Only pantry stays a github git-dep, so the nested wall PERSISTS (greenroom -> pantry(git) -> tjakoen.github.io(git)); still lockless, still runs from THIS checkout's node_modules (grain@0.1.0 = grain main tip 1f5f120 carries b-select/chip-group/stat-tile/b-meter/status-list + the focus-ring fix natively, so a future clean install supersedes the vendored copies). The pins were repointed DECLARATIVELY only — node_modules was intentionally NOT regenerated (the wall still blocks it). deps:refresh now sha-pins pantry and 'bun update's the four published layers.
